verifications.claim: Dusty May is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Michigan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "currently the Wolverines men's basketball head coach at the University of Michigan." (R1); "Michigan basketball coach Dusty May" (R2); "Dusty May was named the David and Meredith Kaplan Men’s Basketball Head Coach" (R3); "Michigan basketball coach Dusty May" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly confirm Dusty May's current role as head coach at Michigan.

verifications.claim: Dusty May was hired on March 24, 2024, as the 18th head coach in Michigan men's basketball history.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "On March 23, 2024, May was named the 18th head basketball coach at the University of Michigan" (R1); "named ... in March 2024, becoming the 18th coach" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References state March 23, 2024 (R1) or March 2024 (R3), directly contradicting the claim's specific date of March 24; 18th coach is supported.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "May was hired by Michigan in 2024, replacing Juwan Howard." (R1); "turning an 8-24 team under Juwan Howard into a 27-10 record" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Both references directly state Dusty May replaced Juwan Howard.
